name: Album of Miscellaneous Subjects, Leaf 10
aliases: Album of Miscellaneous Subjects 山水花鳥圖冊
material: album leaf, ink and color on silk
summary: Leaf 10 Zhou Yi's colophon reads: Green bamboos stand alone with a snowy covering, In the deep recesses of a secluded valley, the evening breeze is light. White egrets are lean as shadows with the cold ripples frozen, They enter the gorge not just to admire the fish.
